title: A finite cycle certificate for permanent-service cash solvency
checked_scope: The source's finite state/action pathwise solvency game with a fixed stationary policy, then existence over stationary policies.
significance: Characterizes finite required reserves by absence of reachable negative cash cycles, provides an exact simple-path reserve formula, and proves a universal finite-state reserve bound when operation is viable.
